mapper.insert: INSERT INTO forum_likes (topic_id, user_id, created_at) VALUES (#{topicId}, #{userId}, #{createdAt})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM forum_likes WHERE topic_id = #{topicId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM forum_likes WHERE topic_id = #{topicId} AND user_id = #{userId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM forum_likes WHERE topic_id = #{topicId}

SELECT fl.id, fl.created_at AS likedAt, t.id AS topicId, t.title, t.view_count AS viewCount, t.reply_count AS replyCount, t.like_count AS likeCount, t.created_at AS topicCreatedAt, u.username AS authorName, c.name AS categoryName FROM forum_likes fl JOIN forum_topics t ON fl.topic_id = t.id AND t.status = 1 JOIN users u ON t.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN forum_categories c ON t.category_id = c.id WHERE fl.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY fl.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM forum_likes WHERE user_id = #{userId}
